description:
Perform a quality assurance audit on the currently loaded patient scan in Blue Sky Plan.

Context: Your lab manager needs to verify if the current scan meets the 0.3mm voxel size requirement for surgical guide fabrication.

Task:
1. Locate the technical properties of the loaded volume (Voxel Size and Volume Dimensions).
   - Look for panels named 'Volume Properties', 'Model Information', or 'DICOM Tags'.
   - These are often found in the 'Panels' menu or by right-clicking the volume in the object list.
2. Create a text file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\scan_audit.txt'.
3. Record the exact Voxel Size (in mm) and Volume Dimensions (in pixels/slices) in the file using the following format:

   Voxel Size: 0.3 x 0.3 x 0.3 mm
   Dimensions: 512 x 512 x 400

   (Replace the numbers with the actual values found in the software).
4. Save the file.
